# Dongfeng Johor Bahru (MyKar World), Dongfeng EV 3S centre in Johor Bahru, Malaysia

> Dongfeng Johor Bahru is the first Dongfeng 3S centre in Johor Bahru (sales, service and spare parts) for Dongfeng passenger electric cars. It sells the Dongfeng Vigo Premier 120kW (5-seat electric SUV, 51.87 kWh LFP battery, 471 km range, 500 L boot; colours Mosswood Green, Canyon Orange, Arctic White, Sandstone Beige, Titanium Silver, Cyber Black) and the Dongfeng 007 (electric fastback sedan, 73.48 kWh LFP battery; Long Range RWD Premium 200 kW, 650 km CLTC / 530 km WLTP, 0-100 km/h 5.8 s; AWD Prime 400 kW / 544 PS, 565 km CLTC / 389 km WLTP, 0-100 km/h 3.9 s; DC 30-80% in about 11 min; colours Celestial White, Eclipse Grey, Obsidian Black, Starlit Silver). Warranty: 8 years unlimited mileage powertrain, 6 years unlimited mileage vehicle. Coming soon: the Voyah Dream luxury MPV (Voyah is Dongfeng's luxury brand; previewed by Dongfeng Malaysia at KLIMS 2026); Malaysian specs, price and launch date not announced yet. Showroom hours: Monday to Saturday 9am-6pm, Sunday 10am-4pm. Workshop hours: Monday to Friday 9am-6pm, Saturday 9am-1pm, Sunday closed. Scheduled service every 10,000 km; service and spare parts follow Dongfeng list prices. Address: No. 28, Jalan Ekoperniagaan 3/11, Taman Ekoperniagaan, 81100 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. WhatsApp or call +60 18-762 0828. Email marketing@mykar.my. Operated by MyKar World Sdn. Bhd., company no. 202501050786 (1652194-X). Test drives by WhatsApp appointment. Prices are given on request, not published. Languages: English, Bahasa Melayu, Chinese. Also open to dealer, brand and fleet partnerships in Johor. Logo: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/drdigital641/edwin-ai-monitor-android@0678e88/site-assets/dongfeng-jb/icon-512.png (red Dongfeng emblem). Google Business Profile and reviews: https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/g/11nc0ckknp&q=MyKar+World+Sdn+Bhd . Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dongfengjohorbahru
